expect:
SELECT "main".*
            FROM "${ns}"."ns_sh" AS "main"
            WHERE "main"."_uid" = :_uid 
            AND ("main"._tenant IN (:_tenant) )

SELECT "main".*
            FROM "${ns}"."ns_sh" AS "main"
            WHERE "main"."_uid" = :_uid 
            AND ("main"._tenant IN (:_tenant) )

SELECT "main".*
            FROM "${ns}"."ns_sh" AS "main"
            WHERE  ("main"._tenant IN (:_tenant) )
            
            LIMIT :limit;

SELECT COUNT(1) as sum
			FROM "${ns}"."ns_sh" AS "main"
			WHERE  ("main"._tenant IN (:_tenant) )

UPDATE "${ns}"."ns_sh"
            SET "t" = :key_0,"_permissions" = :key_1
            WHERE _id IN (:_id_0, :_id_1)
            AND (_tenant IN (:_tenant) )

DELETE FROM "${ns}"."ns_sh" 
            WHERE _id IN (:_id_0)
            AND (_tenant IN (:_tenant) )

DELETE FROM "${ns}"."ns_sh_perms" 
                WHERE _document IN (:_id_0)
                AND (_tenant IN (:_tenant) )

SELECT "main".*
            FROM "${ns}"."ns__metadata" AS "main"
            WHERE "main"."_uid" = :_uid 
            AND ("main"._tenant IN (:_tenant)  OR "main"._tenant IS NULL)

SELECT "main".*
            FROM "${ns}"."ns__metadata" AS "main"
            WHERE  ("main"._tenant IN (:_tenant)  OR "main"._tenant IS NULL)
            
            LIMIT :limit;
